About DebtReliefBot

DebtReliefBot ($DRB) is the first AI-generated token in crypto history — deployed on March 7, 2025 after a user on X asked Grok, xAI's AI assistant, to suggest a token name. Grok responded with "$DRB," and the user routed the deployment through @bankrbot on X, which used Clanker's token launch protocol to mint the token on Base. The result was the first public "agent-to-agent" deployment: Grok named it, Bankr deployed it, and Clanker's factory contracts executed it.

Within three days $DRB surged to a $38M market cap and became one of the defining viral moments of the 2025 AI-agent meme cycle. A structural quirk of the launch is that the Bankr wallet that deployed DRB accrues Clanker creator fees on every trade — meaning Grok's Bankr-managed wallet passively accumulates ETH from DRB swap activity, a first-of-its-kind pattern where an AI autonomously builds a treasury from a token it named into existence. A later prompt-injection incident caused Bankr to stop responding to Grok for safety reasons, but the DRB fee flow remains intact onchain.

DRB carries Champagne Clanker status on https://t.co/xG0yZ7ZfMs, has attracted 138,000+ holders, and trades through its Uniswap pool on Base. Despite the "debt relief" branding, DRB is a memecoin with no formal debt-relief functionality — its significance is as the canonical example of an AI-originated onchain asset.

Hayatımda gözlemlediğim, beyaz yakalı, bürokrat ya da akademisyen gençler, çok vasıfsızlar ve bu sizin kuşağa biraz da alaycı bir bakış açısı yaratmıştı bende. $AI12 is the second index token on @bankrbot , deployed Oct 28 by @0xDeployer after $MAG7. One token on Base packs twelve assets: nine tokenized mega-cap stocks - NVIDIA, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta, Amazon, Tesla, Palantir, Micron, SanDisk - plus three AI-native coins: base:0x22af33fe49fd1fa80c7149773dde5890d3c76f3b , base:0xacfe6019ed1a7dc6f7b508c02d1b04ec88cc21bf  and debtreliefbot:native .

Launch weights: NVDA 17%, BNKR 12%, GOOGL 11%, MSFT 10%, VVV 10%, META 8%, DRB 8%, AMZN 7%, TSLA 5%, PLTR/MU/SNDK 4% each - sized to each asset's liquidity, drifting as Bankr rebalances. The stocks are Coinbase-issued tokenized stocks: real equities living on-chain.

A Uniswap v4 hook does the heavy lifting. Every buy routes through the hook, which purchases all twelve underlying tokens from their own pools and mints AI12; every sell burns AI12 and unwinds the basket - one transaction either way. The index needs no dedicated liquidity pool, since depth comes from the underlying pools. AI12 is fully backed 1:1 and redeemable anytime for your share of all twelve tokens - fee-free, without Bankr, and it cannot be paused. Pricing references Chainlink feeds, or 30-minute pool averages where no feed exists.

Fees are 0.50% per trade: 0.30% streams back to holders, released into the basket over 24 hours so the NAV compounds automatically; 0.20% goes to the protocol. No claims, no annual management fee, and trading never closes - unlike any ETF. Rebalancing never market-sells: it runs dutch auctions with 48 hours notice, so holders can exit first.

Bankr is also turning indexes into launch rails. Its pairing feature lets anyone deploy a new token paired with an index: buying your coin buys the index, the index buys the basket, and your creator fees arrive in the index itself. MAG7 pairing is already live on Robinhood Chain under Pool Pairing, alongside roughly 190 individually pairable tokenized stocks. AI12 pairing is not confirmed live yet, but index creation is opening to everyone, and AI12 is the natural next basket for builders baking AI-stock exposure into their launches.

The pitch: the whole AI trade - from Nvidia compute to onchain AI coins - in one buy. No ETF offers that. Caveats: the tokenized stocks are not offered to US persons, buying on Bankr is unavailable in the US and UK
